stories.headline: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
stories.summary: The iPhone maker appears to be building agents that can compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots.

stories.headline: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
stories.summary: At the upgraded $83/share IPO price, Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million, while the company nabbed nearly $105 billion.

stories.headline: Anthropic rival says companies can (mostly) skip the pricey models
stories.summary: On the day Anthropic went public, Fireworks AI’s co-founder made the case for open source models as a cheaper alternative, and addressed the breaches that have cost the company some customers’ trust.

stories.headline: Want to see your live AI usage on your Mac’s icons? This clever new app lets you
stories.summary: IconSwapper brings your Mac's app icons to life with real-time data, animations, and playful customizations that make your desktop more fun.

stories.headline: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
stories.summary: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg , which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant.

stories.headline: Iran may be working on biological weapons, Trump says
stories.summary: President Trump told Fox News there are indications Iran may be working on biological or chemical weapons as the war drags on toward its ninth month.

stories.headline: White House national cyber director leaving his post
stories.summary: White House National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross will be leaving his position, a White House official told CBS News.

stories.headline: Army delays detonation in Iowa that could send toxic dust into Illinois
stories.summary: The U.S. Army has delayed plans to detonate unstable explosives at a munition plant in Iowa, amid concerns about the risks of a plume of dust containing toxic lead particles that could spread across parts of Iowa and Illinois.

stories.headline: UK and EU to agree youth mobility scheme, BBC understands
stories.summary: The scheme is expected to be approved at Friday's UK-EU summit, with new deals on food trade and carbon emissions also on the table.
